newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta insurance company in record growth.
newsitem.headline: Malta insurance company in record growth.

text.p: Malta's Middle Sea Valletta, a life insurance firm, has announced record growth for 1996, with gross total premiums written rising by 71 per cent to 5.8 million pounds (14.9m) from 3.4 million Malta pounds ($8.77m) in the previous year.
The company which is the result of a joint venture between Bank of Valletta and Middle Sea Insurance said the total life fund rose by 79 per cent to 10 million pounds from 5.6 million pounds.
Company chairman John C. Grech said the performance represents an encouraging sign for the company's shareholders, staff, producers, existing and future policyholders.
Pre-tax profits for 1996 went up to 472,144 pounds from 91,499 pounds the year before, while the net asset value expanded to 1.21 pounds from 1.02 pounds.
